gueter.kette.bauVerzug: Material and energy shortages have delayed this project by {tage} days so far.
akte.wirtschaft.instrument.inventarText: Supply routes, stocks and effects on the economy and war
gueter.leer: The inventory is created when the game starts.
gueter.einleitung: The country covers {autark} of {gesamt} goods groups itself. For the rest it depends on supplier countries, sea lanes and pipelines.
gueter.jahr: Quantities per year; stocks and shortfalls are computed monthly.
gueter.beispiel: {name}: production about {produktion}, consumption about {verbrauch} {einheit}; grown in {orte}.
gueter.ruestungHinweis: Self-sufficiency in defence goods follows defence autonomy in the policy network; quantities and stocks are kept in the military file.
gueter.satz.fehl: {name}: Stocks are empty, about {fehl} % of monthly demand is missing. Prices are rising.
gueter.satz.lager: {name}: {anteil} % of imports are cut off; stocks still cover the gap.
gueter.satz.selbst: {name}: The country supplies itself; the surplus is exported.
gueter.satz.knapp: {name}: Self-sufficiency {autarkie} %, the rest comes from the world market.
gueter.wirkung.reserve: Orders one month of demand. At least 30 days, with partial deliveries during shortages. Funds committed on order.
gueter.wirkung.freigabe: Lowers the stock target by one month of demand. Fewer replenishment purchases; existing stocks remain available for shortages.
gueter.wirkung.foerderung: A year of export credit and trade fairs: more exports and foreign currency, at a cost to the budget.
gueter.wirkung.stopp: Keeps export goods at home and supports supply. Actual export receipts fall.
gueter.wirkung.quelle: New supply contracts after 30 days: halves partner and Hormuz disruption, rerouting costs up to 15% more. Transport capacity remains limited.
gueter.grund.nicht: That is not possible right now.
gueter.erg.reserve: Reserve shipment for {name} ordered. Stock increases only upon delivery.
gueter.erg.freigabe: Stock target for {name} lowered. Existing stocks remain available.
gueter.erg.quelle: New supply contracts for {name} agreed; transition in 30 days.
gueter.linse.ressourcen.hinweis: Strong colour means world rank. Among the neighbours: {ausland}.
gueter.linse.strategie.hinweis: Outside the country the key ones are: {orte}.
gueter.ampel.gruen: Stocks last more than three months without imports.
gueter.ampel.gelb: Without imports it gets tight within three months.
gueter.ampel.rot: Without imports stocks run out in under a month.
gueter.kette.ersteBilanz: First settlement at the start of next month
gueter.kette.handelsbeitragText: Actual deliveries in {monat}, at reference prices. Replaces the aggregate sector contribution.
gueter.kette.zusammenhang: Disruptions draw down stocks. Missing energy and inputs constrain production next month; actual imports and exports change foreign-currency needs.
gueter.kette.kampfkraft: Fuel-related combat effectiveness: {faktor}%. Material coverage for production and upgrades: {material}%.
gueter.kette.prioritaetHinweis: Effective from the next monthly settlement. Priorities do not create goods: the other side bears the shortage.
gueter.kette.vorschauHinweis: Forecast in {einheit}, assuming current conditions. Deliveries and effects settle monthly.
gueter.kette.rechnung: Import bill {import} bn $ · Export receipts {export} bn $. Reference prices; global price and currency effects are recorded separately in the external accounts.
gueter.kette.vorprodukte: Inputs limit production to {n}% of otherwise available output.
gueter.kette.transport: Transport capacity: {n}%. Port congestion limits seaborne deliveries. Expansion and reduced load help.
gueter.kette.hormus: Hormuz disruption affects {n}% of imports before rerouting.
gueter.kette.auftrag: Reserve order pending: {menge} {einheit}. No earlier than {datum}; partial deliveries subject to capacity at monthly settlement.
gueter.kette.auftragOffen: A reserve shipment for these goods is already pending.
gueter.kette.quelleTermin: New supply contracts no earlier than {datum}. Existing routes remain in use until then.
gueter.kette.warnung: Supply shortage in {name}: {fehl}% of civilian demand unmet. Check routes and reserves in the inventory.
